report: initial classifiers report (2026-10-22): an initial setup, sanity-checked on 15 recorded runs, not tuned; combined by maximum since 2026-10-23 (graph tune plan, unit A), so a sweep-only brief fires alone: max 1.0 less the small-size feature 0.3 is 0.7, above the cut-off

note.text: the build brief, the plan the builders were given

deliverables_listed.instructions: Count the deliverables the brief lists, in its deliverables, target files, or parts sections: each file to create or change, command, function, config key, migration, document, or test, one item per line. About how many are there?

sweep_or_removal.instructions: Does the brief require a sweep or a removal: a name, phrase, file, or setting that must be gone everywhere, a rename across many files, or a wording that must change at every place it appears?

criteria.true: The brief requires that something be removed, renamed, or reworded at every place it appears, across several files.
criteria.false: The brief names the places to change one by one, with no sweep, removal, or rename across the repo.

parts_listed.instructions: How many parts, slices, or separately numbered units of work does the brief split the work into?
criteria: No split: one unit of work.
